core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aaiz is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who seeks refuge, sheltering”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aaiz corresponds to the Arabic form عائذ (Arabic root ع و ذ (ʿ-w-dh); عَائِذ (ʿĀʾidh)). Its core sense is one who seeks refuge, sheltering. Aaiz is Arabic عَائِذ (ʿĀʾidh) 'one who seeks refuge, sheltering', from the root ع و ذ (ʿ-w-dh). The source gloss 'Helpful, Assisting' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
